2026 Candidate Interview: Pamela Monville for 51st District Court Judge

(Crystal A. Proxmire, July 21, 2026)

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:19
Instaread

Waterford, MI – In the race for Judge of the 51st District Court, there are two candidates: Carmen DeFranco and Pamela Monville.

The 51st District Court serves Waterford Township.

The election takes place Nov. 3, 2026.

For other interviews visit our Candidate Interview Page.

For a complete list of candidates and ballot issues, visit the Oakland County Clerk’s Election Page.

Also check out the State of Michigan Election Page for info on where to vote and more.

The Oakland County Bar Association is proud to sponsor the judicial candidate interview series as part of our efforts to educate the public about the law, the role of judges and lawyers, and the administration of justice.

Learn more about the candidates and our judicial candidate forums at ocba.org/judicial_candidates.

The OCBA does not endorse any of the candidates.

Oakland County Times does not endorse any candidates, and advertising does not imply endorsement. All candidates are welcome to do interviews. Contact editor@oc115.com for more information.

New videos are added frequently up until Election Day, so please check back often!
